description: Play a sequence of opening moves on a chess board: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 showing the Italian game opening.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_chess import Board, play_game

DEFAULT_FEN = "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1"

class ChessBoardMultiMove(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        board = Board()
        board.set_board_from_FEN(DEFAULT_FEN)
        self.add(board)
        moves = [
            ('e2', 'e4', ''),
            ('e7', 'e5', ''),
            ('g1', 'f3', ''),
        ]
        play_game(self, board, moves, animation_time=0.4)
        self.wait(0.3)
